sb.name: Ash Zombie
sb.languages: understands all languages it spoke in life but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Ash Puff
traits.desc: The first time the zombie takes damage, any living creature within 5 feet of the zombie must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on it early with a successful save.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The mage is a 4th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13; +5 to hit with spell attacks). The mage knows the following spells from the wizard's spell list:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]]

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: Gundren has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Mormesk the Wraith
sb.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The wraith can move through an object or another creature, but can't stop there.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. If this attack reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Nezznar has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: Nezznar has disadvantage on attack rolls when he or his target is in sunlight.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Nezznar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]] (save DC 12)

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Nezznar is a 4th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13; +5 to hit with spell attacks). Nezznar has the following spells prepared from the wizard's spell list:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Frost|ray of frost]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]

actions.name: Spider Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: Nundro has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ruffian makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: When an attacker hits Sildar with a melee attack and Sildar can see the attacker, he can roll 1d6 and add the number rolled to his AC against the triggering attack, provided that he's wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Venomfang
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Venomfang can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Venomfang makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Venomfang exhales poisonous gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
